workload_families.name: short_batch
workload_families.description: Short-job dominated, batch release: 15 jobs of 1-4 time units, all released together.

workload_families.name: short_stream
workload_families.description: Short-job dominated, staggered release: 15 jobs of 1-4 time units arriving within a 30-unit window (no long jobs).

workload_families.name: long_batch
workload_families.description: Long-job dominated, batch release: 15 jobs of 20-50 time units, all released together.

workload_families.name: interactive
workload_families.description: Interactive/response-sensitive: a small batch of long background jobs (60-100 units) released at the head of the window plus a stream of 18 very short interactive jobs (1-2 units) over 50 time units.

workload_families.name: interactive_sparse
workload_families.description: Interactive with a sparser arrival stream: the same job mix as 'interactive' but the short jobs arrive over 110 time units (lighter load, slower interactive traffic).

workload_families.name: priority_aligned
workload_families.description: Priority-sensitive with importance aligned to job size: uniform bursts 1-50, and the shortest jobs carry the highest priority (priority assigned by burst rank).

workload_families.name: priority_skewed
workload_families.description: Priority-sensitive with skewed priority labels uncorrelated with job size: uniform bursts 1-50 and 70% of the priorities in the band 1-2.

workload_families.name: quantum_sensitive
workload_families.description: Quantum-sensitive/preemption-heavy: 20 jobs of 2-12 time units straddling the Round-Robin quantum (4), arriving within a 30-unit window; preemption is frequent and costly.

workload_families.name: mixed
workload_families.description: Mixed: 15 jobs with bursts uniform over the full 1-50 range, arriving within a 20-unit window.
